BLUEPRINT:1,51,1127,2104,1107,1403,1803,0,639199905502219934,0.10.34.28529,Antimatter%20Rod%20Farm%20%28NQ%29%20v3,,,,Requires%20145%20GW%20of%20Dyson%20Sphere%20Power%20at%2099%25%20Ray%20Receiver%20Efficiency.%2010%20of%20these%20fit%20on%20a%20planet%20planet.%0A%0AInputs%3A%20Blue%20Proliferator%2C%20Deuterium%2C%2014.7k%20Iron%20Ore%2C%201k%20Sulfur%2C%201k%20Titanium%20Ore%2C%204.3k%20Silicon%20Ore%2C%206.5k%20Copper%20Ore%2C%201.2k%20Fire%20Ice%2C%20Warpers.%0A%0AProduces%20900%20Antimatter%20rods%20a%20minute%20and%20will%20power%20itself%20and%20max%20power%20draw%20once%20up%20and%20running.%20%0A%0AThere%20is%20a%20fairly%20large%20overflow%20of%20critical%20photons%20%281800%2Fminute%29%20so%20the%20ILS%20that%20collects%20them%20is%20set%20to%20ship%20out.%20Use%20as%20you%20see%20fit.%0A%0AThere%20is%20also%20an%20ILS%20set%20to%200%20for%20graviton%20lens%20and%20remote%20receive.%20Increase%20the%20number%20above%20zero%20if%20you%20want%20to%20bring%20in%20graviton%20lens%20to%20support%20the%20number%20being%20produced%20natively.%20The%20BP%20WILL%20fill%20the%20belt%20over%20time%2C%20but%20it%20will%20take%20about%2018%20hours%20to%20catch%20up%20from%20start%20if%20producing%20100%25.%20You%20can%20ship%20some%20in%20at%20the%20start%20to%20jump%20start%20all%20the%20ray%20receivers%20if%20you%20want%20and%20turn%20it%20off%20later.%20%0A%0AThe%20belt%20cycling%20strange%20matter%20on%20the%20outside%20is%20decorative%20and%20serves%20no%20purpose.%20""E61A4966A22B9127DC242E9C6FC5B88B
